claims: Mexico defeated Brazil 16-0 in a 2026 World Baseball Classic matchup on March 8, 2026
The victory was a mercy-rule victory
The game featured four home runs
Mexico improved to 2-0 in Pool B
Mexico's victory eliminated Brazil from the tournament
The victory was tied for the third-largest margin in World Baseball Classic history
Alejandro Kirk delivered a three-run homer in the fourth inning
The venue was Daikin Park, Houston, TX
Mexico defeated Brazil 3-2 in an April 2026 "Legends" match
